nina-sales: Heartwood asked for a BCP/DR appendix for the SIG. They want RTO/RPO, backup cadence, and a short SLA paragraph to paste in their vendor portal. Can we finalize by EOD?

marta-sre: We ran a full control-plane failover on 2026-03-22; timeline shows recovery with smoke tests in 20 minutes. I can provide sanitized report.

sam-platform: Key points: multi-AZ frontends, WAL streaming for metadata, checkpoint replication every 5 minutes, and async log replication. Note that ephemeral KV/cache is best-effort.

nina-sales: Legal: can we share day-level timestamps and duration? @security-bot advice?

security-bot: SIG updated (Q12-Q15). Sharing day + duration ok; redact PII and internal hostnames. (automation)

marta-sre: Draft summary: Hosted: target RTO 12-15m; observed 20m during last test. Dedicated: target RTO 8-10m intra-region; cross-region reprovisioning up to 90-120m. Private: customer-dependent. RPO: control-plane metadata <=60s; checkpoints every 5m; ephemeral session state not guaranteed. Backups: incremental every 6 hours, 14-day retention default; logs 90-day for enterprise.

nina-sales: Great. I'll post the SIG answer with links to sanitized artifacts and hold pricing for 7 days.

marta-sre: Uploaded sanitized-runbook-2026-03-22.pdf and postmortem-2026-03-22.pdf to secure share: https://redwood-secure-share/heartwood/dr-evidence-1803009999 (access: nina-sales, sam-platform).

nina-sales: Posting now. Will ping if they ask for a joint drill. Thanks!
